correctness.rationale: The sufficiently subdivided unordered two-particle graph cubical complex has cell counts c0=C(2m+2,2), c1=6m², c2=(7m²-5m)/2. Explicit distinct free 1-faces remove A_iC_i, off-diagonal A_iB_j and B_iC_j, subsequently off-diagonal A_iC_j, then B_iB_j, exhausting every square and leaving a connected graph. Hence X_m is a wedge of C(m,2) circles integrally. The arm-permutation and pole-swap operations preserve the cubical model; signed cell traces yield tr(H1)=(-1)^epsilon(C(f,2)-t), matching wedge²Q^m tensored with the pole-swap sign. Under S_m the character does not contain trivial representation. The actual theta_two_config_verify.py implements incidence/free-face tests for finite m=3..10, not an unbounded proof; independently checked exterior-square trace identity for m=3..10. Key uniform free-face and signed trace cases were read from RESULT.md.
